I can't move between the cards with the arrow keys anymore. Could you bring that back and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and follow its linked requirements for this project.

Restored arrow-key movement in [Board.tsx](/work/src/game/board/Board.tsx:41). Unmodified arrows move within the same row or column, stop at board edges, and focus cards with the existing scroll behavior. Modified arrows and native Enter/Space behavior remain unchanged.

Verification passed: type checking, 138 unit tests, all 75 browser journeys, and 4 keyboard journeys against a fresh build with the named runtime guard. The edited file passes Prettier. The workspace-wide format check still flags other untouched files.
